import json, os, signal, subprocess, sys, time
signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, signal.SIG_IGN)
child = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, '-B', '-S', '-c', "import os, signal, time\nsignal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, signal.SIG_IGN)\nprint('READY', os.getpid(), os.getpgrp(), flush=True)\ntime.sleep(60)\n"], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
ready = child.stdout.readline().strip().split()
if len(ready) != 3 or ready[0] != 'READY':
    raise RuntimeError('descendant readiness handshake failed')
print(json.dumps({'record': 'cleanup-ready', 'parent_pid': os.getpid(), 'parent_pgid': os.getpgrp(), 'descendant_pid': int(ready[1]), 'descendant_pgid': int(ready[2])}), flush=True)
time.sleep(60)
